accentAt.description:
Default 1 (any update colours the icon); a whole number, 1 and up.

Takes a whole number, 1 and up. Default: 1.

warnAt.description:
Default 30; a whole number, not below "accentAt".

Takes a whole number, 1 and up. Default: 30.

errorAt.description:
Default 150; a whole number, not below "warnAt". Out of order, all three take their defaults.

Takes a whole number, 1 and up. Default: 150.

icon.description:
The icon's colour when updates are waiting: the muted ink below "accentAt" updates, the accent
from "accentAt", the warn colour from "warnAt", the error colour from "errorAt" on. The count is the
status count: a package group (three or more packages of one repo sharing a prefix, qemu-* for one)
counts as ONE update here, and every other package as one. The popup and the lockscreen show the
real number of packages.

everyMin.description:
Minutes between two checks for updates; 0: only when you ask. Default 15; 0 .. 1440.

Takes a number 0 .. 1440. Default: 15.

staleMin.description:
Opening the popup checks again when the last check is at least this many minutes old. Default 5; 0 .. 1440.

Takes a number 0 .. 1440. Default: 5.

official.description:
What is asked: the official repositories, the AUR, flatpak. One that is false is never asked and never listed.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

aur.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

flatpak.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

view.description:
The view the popup opens on when no update runs: "quiet" | "normal" | "verbose", or "last" (the one you left). While an update runs, and until
its end has been seen, it is the run's own.

Takes "quiet", "normal", "verbose" or "last". Default: "quiet".

groupMin.x-wants: a whole number 0 .. 0, or a whole number 2 .. 20
groupMin.description:
This many packages of one repository with a common prefix become one group (qemu-*). 0: no groups. Default 3; 0, 2 .. 20.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 0, or a whole number 2 .. 20. Default: 3.

open.description:
The categories whose lists are open when the popup opens: "core", "extra", "multilib", "aur", "flatpak" ..., or "all".

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

flags.description: Takes a list of texts. Default: ["--sudoloop"].

run.description: Options handed to yay after -Syu, each a flag of its own ("--devel", "--answerdiff=None"). Default ["--sudoloop"] (the password is asked once).
